note: Reference ladder for EmuBench 1. Each console is measured in the lab on its reference device with a pinned emulator build; scenes are x-real-console-speed from accepted 3-pass runs (spread <= 3%, 10 s window). required_checks is the accuracy gate: exactly the pinned checks the reference build passed in its own run (reference_accuracy, failures included). Measured 2026-11-27 on an RG35XX SP class H700 (performance governor, on USB power, SoC cooled below 78 C before each scene), timing worker b55710dc. Until a console has scenes here it is uncalibrated and no Device score is given.
